data.exact_reserve_text:
Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 8.8m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2022 (2021 GBP 5.7m).
The reserve release was primarily due to the favourable development across Property classes partially offset by adverse development on the Legal Indemnities class.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a net release of prior year reserves of GBP 8.8m net of reinsurance, driven by favourable development in Property classes partially offset by adverse development in Legal Indemnities. However, on a gross basis (before reinsurance) analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates an aggregate strengthening of prior-year reserves of approximately GBP 20.1m. This divergence indicates significant reinsurance recoveries/movement affecting the net outcome; movements are concentrated in the older underwriting years (2018-2020) across property and indemnity related lines.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The report explicitly states a net release of GBP 8.8m (net of reinsurance). No explicit gross prior-year movement figure is provided; therefore a gross prior-year development amount was derived from the published gross claims development triangle. The gross-derived figure (~+GBP 20.08m strengthening) contrasts with the reported net release, indicating material reinsurance recoveries. Triangle numbers are reported in GBP '000 in the source; extraction and alignment required interpreting the printed triangle rows. Confidence in the gross triangle extraction is moderate-high (0.8).
